reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount by calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the expected-amount rule stays in the one shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in the API model's toExternal mapping and type, where the tree shapes API schedule output.

scope.why: Two-line change limited to the API schedule model and its type.

maintainability.why: Simple and clear; the optional field on APIScheduleEntity is also accepted on input with no note that it is read-only.
